platformSnapshot.status: Live ~1 month, 0 paid enrollments, 2 founders, no sales team
platformSnapshot.coreOffer: 60-Day Data Analytics (SQL, Excel, Python) interactive practice platform

agencyCoreInsights.unitEconomicsWarning: At ₹990, 100 enrollments yield only ₹99k, making paid ads unprofitable. At ₹1,999, 100 enrollments yield ₹1.99L, allowing ₹75k-₹1L ad spend if CAC is under ₹800.
keyShortcomingsIdentified: Ticket size ₹990 is too low for pure paid scaling without upselling bundles
Zero social proof, testimonials, or brand trust currently displayed
Lack of automated instant lead capture and WhatsApp nurture sequence

funnelChecklistHighlights.stage1_attention: Offer clarity in 5s, audience split (freshers vs career switchers), test 3-5 creatives/mo, track Cost Per Enrollment (CPE) not just CPL
funnelChecklistHighlights.stage2_nurture: Instant WhatsApp auto-reply < 5 mins, CRM lead stages, min 6 follow-up touchpoints, hot/warm/cold lead scoring
funnelChecklistHighlights.stage3_enrollment: Understand->Diagnose->Prescribe->Close script, token fee booking, real deadline/urgency, dead lead reactivation (30-180 days)

marketingMadamVerdict.takeaway: Proposal has solid unit economics logic on the ₹1,999+ pricing ladder and the 5-min WhatsApp speed-to-lead rule. However, Manodemy should NOT pay agency retainers. Instead, adopt their pricing ladder + automated WhatsApp nurture into our in-house PLG and viral reel engine for maximum profit.
